title: Closed-Form Last Layer Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2510.04606v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural networks are typically optimized with variants of stochastic gradient descent. Under a squared loss, however, the optimal solution to the linear last layer weights is known in closed-form. We propose to leverage this during optimization, treating the last layer as a function of the backbone parameters, and optimizing solely for these parameters. We show this is equivalent to alternating between gradient descent steps on the backbone and closed-form updates on the last layer. We adapt the method for the setting of stochastic gradient descent, by trading off the loss on the current batch against the accumulated information from previous batches. We provide theoretical analyses showing convergence of the method to an optimal solution in the neural tangent kernel regime, as well as quantifying the gains compared to standard SGD in a one-step analysis. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach compared with SG

translated_abstract: 神经网络通常使用随机梯度下降的各种变体进行优化。然而，在平方损失下，线性最后一层权重的最优解是已知的闭式解。我们提出在优化过程中利用这一点，将最后一层视为主干网络参数的函数，仅针对这些参数进行优化。我们证明这等价于在主干网络上进行梯度下降步骤与对最后一层进行闭式更新之间的交替。我们针对随机梯度下降的设定对该方法进行了适配，通过在当前批次上的损失与先前批次积累的信息之间进行权衡。我们提供了理论分析，表明该方法在神经正切核机制下收敛到最优解，并通过一步分析量化了与标准SGD相比的增益。最后，我们证明了我们的方法与SGD相比的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出在平方损失下将神经网络最后一层权重视为主干参数的闭式解函数，仅优化主干参数并在随机梯度下降设定下进行适配，理论上证明了该方法在神经正切核机制下收敛到最优解且优于标准SGD。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes treating the last layer weights as a closed-form function of backbone parameters under squared loss, adapting the method to stochastic gradient descent, and theoretically proving convergence to optimal solutions in the NTK regime with gains over standard SGD.
